facts.text: Vassek was relatively obscure by the time of the Clone Wars, though became less so following a confrontation between the Separatist General Grievous and a Galactic Republic task force on Vassek 3.

evidence.quote: Vassek was relatively obscure by the time of the Clone Wars, though became less so following a confrontation between the Separatist General Grievous and a Galactic Republic task force on Vassek 3.

facts.text: During the Imperial Era, the Vassek farmer Roni made plans to steal Imperial generators.

evidence.quote: During the Imperial Era, the Vassek farmer Roni made plans to steal Imperial generators.

facts.text: After viper probe droid Viper 058-V-2353's investigations on the world uncovered their plot, the farmer and two of their family members were arrested by an Imperial Security Bureau agent, and a report of the probe droid's endeavors was kept on a datapad.

evidence.quote: After viper probe droid Viper 058-V-2353's investigations on the world uncovered their plot, the farmer and two of their family members were arrested by an Imperial Security Bureau agent, and a report of the probe droid's endeavors was kept on a datapad.

facts.text: A small blue-and-green planet, it was one of many in the Outer Rim Territories that was named and noted, but whose obscurity and distance from the Koda Spur hyperspace route made it uninteresting to the galaxy.

evidence.quote: A small blue-and-green planet, it was one of many in the Outer Rim Territories that was named and noted, but whose obscurity and distance from the Koda Spur hyperspace route made it uninteresting to the galaxy.

facts.text: The world was orbited by three moons, one of which was Vassek 3.

evidence.quote: The world was orbited by three moons, one of which was Vassek 3.

facts.text: By the time of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Vassek's moon—Vassek 3—was home to Separatist General Grievous's personal fortress.

facts.text: At some point by 3 ABY, the farmer made plans to steal generators from the Galactic Empire; around the same time, a smuggler learned of the anti-Imperial sentiment on Vassek.

evidence.quote: At some point by 3 ABY, the farmer made plans to steal generators from the Galactic Empire; around the same time, a smuggler learned of the anti-Imperial sentiment on Vassek.

facts.text: Upon being captured by the Empire, the smuggler gave up their intel on Vassek, prompting the former to send the viper probe droid Viper 058-V-2353 to investigate.

evidence.quote: Upon being captured by the Empire, the smuggler gave up their intel on Vassek, prompting the former to send the viper probe droid Viper 058-V-2353 to investigate.

facts.text: While on the world, the probe droid conducted surveillance on the local populace by spending six weeks recording conversations between farmers in a Vassek settlement.

evidence.quote: While on the world, the probe droid conducted surveillance on the local populace by spending six weeks recording conversations between farmers in a Vassek settlement.

facts.text: When Viper 058-V-2353 discovered Roni's plans to steal generators, an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau was dispatched to Vassek and arrested the farmer and two adult members of their family.
